scope: Proposition 9.1 (Rectangular projection criterion) of the manuscript “Entanglement with zero distillable secret key in local dimension ten” (preprints/Entanglement-with-zero-distillable-secret-key-in-local-dimension-ten-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 272 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 be18f63c5a1d11a2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Q, K, D be positive integers, let Q be a set of Q elements, and let uq ∈ RK, q ∈ Q, be unit vectors. Put cqr = uT q ur. For each q, let {Pi : i ∈ Iq} be a finite projective measurement on CD: its members are self-adjoint projections, they are mutually orthogonal, and their sum is ID. Zero projections are allowed. Take the label sets Iq disjoint, put I = F q∈Q Iq, and set n = |I|. Suppose that 1. PiPj = PjPi whenever i ∈ Iq, j ∈ Ir, and cqr ̸= 0; 2. there is a real number κ < Q/K such that every J ⊆ I satisfying tr(PiPj) > 0 for all distinct i, j ∈ J has |J| ≤ κ. After ordering I, define the complex-linear map Ψ : Mn(C) → MD(C) on matrix units by Hij = cqrPiPj, Ψ(Eij) = Hij (i ∈ Iq, j ∈ Ir). (9.2) Then Ψ and its Hilbert–Schmidt adjoint Ψ† : MD(C) → Mn(C) are PPT. Moreover, C := J(Ψ† ◦ Ψ) is nonseparable over Cn ⊗ Cn , tr C = Q2 D. (9.3)
